en.s: On 8 February 421, Honorius proclaimed Constantius III his co-emperor in the Western Roman Empire. The Eastern emperor Theodosius II refused to recognize the appointment.

zh.t: 霍诺里乌斯立君士坦提乌斯三世为共治皇帝
zh.s: 421年2月8日，霍诺里乌斯宣布君士坦提乌斯三世为西罗马帝国共治皇帝。东罗马皇帝狄奥多西二世拒绝承认这一任命。

en.s: The Battle of Flochberg (8 February 1150) was a victory for the royal forces of Henry (VI) of Germany over the House of Welf, led by Welf VI and his son, Welf VII. Henry's father, Conrad III, and Welf VI had gone on the Second Crusade together. On his return journey in 1148 Welf had entered into an alliance with Roger II of Sicily, Conrad's enemy.

zh.s: 弗洛赫贝格战役于1150年2月8日发生，德意志国王亨利六世的王室军队击败了韦尔夫家族，由韦尔夫六世及其子韦尔夫七世率领。亨利的父亲康拉德三世曾与韦尔夫六世一同参加第二次十字军东征。韦尔夫于1148年回国途中与康拉德的敌人、西西里国王罗杰二世结盟。

en.s: The siege of Vladimir in February 1238 was part of the Mongol invasion of Kievan Rus'.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1238年2月，蒙古军队围攻弗拉基米尔，这是蒙古入侵基辅罗斯的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Mansurah was fought from 8 to 11 February 1250, between Crusaders led by Louis IX, King of France, and Ayyubid forces led by Egypt's Sultana Shajar al-Durr, vizier Fakhr al-Din ibn al-Shaykh, Faris ad-Din Aktai, Baybars and Qutuz. It was fought in present-day Mansoura, Egypt. The Crusader force was enticed into entering the town where it was set upon by the Muslim force.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1250年2月8日至11日，法国国王路易九世率领的十字军与埃及苏丹摄政沙贾尔·杜尔、维齐尔法赫尔丁·伊本·谢赫、法里斯·丁·阿克泰、拜巴尔和库图兹率领的阿尤布军队在曼苏拉交战。战场位于今埃及曼苏拉。十字军被诱入城中，遭到穆斯林军队袭击。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Agreement ends the Byzantine civil war
en.s: On 8 February 1347, an agreement ended the Byzantine civil war of 1341–1347. John VI Kantakouzenos would serve as senior emperor for ten years, after which he and John V Palaiologos were to rule as equals.

zh.t: 拜占庭内战双方达成共治协议
zh.s: 1347年2月8日，拜占庭内战双方达成协议，结束了始于1341年的内战。约翰六世·坎塔库泽诺斯将担任资深皇帝十年，此后与约翰五世·巴列奥略平等共治。

en.t: Mary, Queen of Scots, executed at Fotheringhay
en.s: On 8 February 1587, Old Style, Mary, Queen of Scots, was executed at Fotheringhay Castle in England, now part of the United Kingdom. She had been tried for involvement in the Babington Plot against Elizabeth I.
en.n: February 8 follows the Julian calendar used in England; the year is given under the January-start convention.

zh.t: 苏格兰女王玛丽在福瑟林盖被处决
zh.s: 1587年旧历2月8日，苏格兰女王玛丽在英格兰福瑟林盖城堡被处决，该地位于今英国。她此前因卷入针对伊丽莎白一世的巴宾顿阴谋受审。
zh.n: 2月8日沿用当时英格兰使用的儒略历，年份按1月起年的惯例记载。

en.s: The siege of Pyongyang was a military conflict fought between the allied Ming-Joseon army and the Japanese First Division under Konishi Yukinaga, who were besieged in the city of Pyongyang. The battle ended in victory for the allies although remnants of the Japanese forces successfully escaped from the city in the night of 8 February 1593.

zh.s: 平壤之战中，明朝与朝鲜联军围攻据守平壤的小西行长率领的日军第一军。联军最终获胜，但日军残部于1593年2月8日夜间成功逃出城外。

en.t: Earl of Essex leads an unsuccessful rising in London
en.s: On 8 February 1601, the Earl of Essex led supporters through London in an attempt to force access to Queen Elizabeth I. The rising failed, and he surrendered that evening after royal forces surrounded Essex House.
en.n: February 8 follows the contemporary Old Style day; the year is rendered as 1601 with the year starting in January.

zh.t: 埃塞克斯伯爵在伦敦发动叛乱失败
zh.s: 1601年2月8日，埃塞克斯伯爵率支持者进入伦敦，企图迫使伊丽莎白一世接见。叛乱未能成功，王室部队包围埃塞克斯府后，他于当晚投降。
zh.n: 2月8日沿用当时的旧历日期，年份按1月起年的惯例记为1601年。

en.s: Battle of Myadel was a battle of the Russo-Polish War (1654–67) which took place on February 8, 1659 near the Belarusian town of Myadzel. The Russian army of Novgorod led by Ivan Khovansky defeated the Polish–Lithuanians led by Mikołaj Judycki and Władysław Wołłowicz. As a result, the Polish-Lithuanian army retreated to the safety of the walls of Lyakhovichi.

zh.s: 1659年2月8日，1654—1667年俄波战争期间，伊万·霍万斯基率领的俄国诺夫哥罗德军队，在白俄罗斯米亚杰利镇附近，击败米科瓦伊·尤迪茨基及瓦迪斯瓦夫·沃沃维奇指挥的波兰立陶宛军队。败军随后退入利亚霍维奇城墙内寻求保护。

en.s: The Sack of Campeche, known to later Spanish historians as Mansfield's Assault, was a 1663 raid by buccaneers led by Christopher Myngs and Edward Mansvelt which became a model for later coastal raids of the buccaneering era.

zh.s: 坎佩切城劫掠又被后来的西班牙历史学家称为“曼斯菲尔德突袭”，是1663年克里斯托弗·明斯和爱德华·曼斯维尔特率领海盗发动的一次袭击，后来成为海盗时代沿海劫掠行动的范例。

en.s: The Schenectady massacre was an attack against the colonial settlement of Schenectady in the English Province of New York on February 8, 1690. A raiding party of 114 French soldiers and militiamen, accompanied by 96 allied Mohawk and Algonquin warriors, attacked the unguarded community, destroying most of the homes, and killing or capturing most of its inhabitants. Sixty residents were killed, including 11 Black slaves.

zh.s: 1690年2月8日，法国士兵和民兵组成的突袭队袭击纽约英属殖民地斯克内克塔迪居民点。突袭队由114人组成，并有96名莫霍克和阿尔冈昆盟军战士随行。居民点没有防备，大部分房屋被毁，多数居民被杀或被俘，60人死亡，其中包括11名黑人奴隶。

en.t: The College of William & Mary in Williamsburg, Virginia, the second-oldest institution of higher education in the Thirteen Colonies, is granted a charter by King William III and Queen Mary II
en.s: The College of William & Mary (W&M) is a public research university in Williamsburg, Virginia, United States. Founded in 1693 under a royal charter issued by King William III and Queen Mary II, it is the second-oldest institution of higher learning in the United States, among the original nine colonial colleges, and the ninth-oldest institution in the English-speaking world.

zh.t: 威廉与玛丽学院获颁特许状
zh.s: 威廉与玛丽学院是位于美国弗吉尼亚州威廉斯堡的一所公立研究型大学，1693年由威廉三世和玛丽二世颁发皇家特许状创立。它是美国第二古老的高等教育机构，也是最初九所殖民地学院之一，在英语世界中历史排名第九。

en.s: The Battle of Oposhnya was a battle which took place on February 8, 1709 during the Swedish invasion of Russia in the Great Northern War. After the costly siege of Veprik the Swedes under Charles XII of Sweden started an offensive against the Russian army in the area. The intention of this offensive was not clear to the Russians, as they subsequently had to spread their main forces out to cover possible attack directions. One of these were the troops under Aleksandr Danilovich Menshikov positioned at Oposhnya on the river Vorskla to block any attempt by the Swedes to cross the river.

zh.s: 1709年2月8日，大北方战争中瑞典入侵俄罗斯期间发生奥波什尼亚战役。付出高昂代价攻占韦普里克后，瑞典国王查理十二世率军向当地俄军发动攻势。俄军不清楚瑞军意图，不得不分散主力，防备各个可能的进攻方向。其中，亚历山大·丹尼洛维奇·缅希科夫所部部署在沃尔斯克拉河畔奥波什尼亚，阻止瑞军渡河。

en.s: The Battle of Campo Santo was fought in Campo Santo, Italy on 8 February 1743 between Spain and Austria, as part of the War of the Austrian Succession. The Spaniards and their Neapolitan allies under General De Gages were fought to a standstill by the Austrians and their Sardinian allies under Field Marshal Traun on the Panaro. The Spanish sustained heavy casualties, but as darkness fell, Traun ordered a general retreat; de Gages, rather than pursue, himself drew back over the river.

zh.s: 1743年2月8日，奥地利王位继承战争期间，西班牙与奥地利在意大利坎波桑托交战。德加热将军指挥西班牙及那不勒斯联军，与特劳恩元帅率领的奥地利及撒丁联军在帕纳罗河一带相持不下。西军伤亡惨重，但夜幕降临时，特劳恩下令全军撤退；德加热没有追击，也率军退回河对岸。

en.s: The Battle of Eylau (also known as the Battle of Preussisch-Eylau) was a bloody and strategically inconclusive battle on 7 and 8 February [O.S. 26 and 27 Jan.] 1807 between Napoleon's Grande Armée and the Imperial Russian Army under the command of General Levin August von Bennigsen near the town of Preussisch Eylau in East Prussia. Late in the battle, the Russians received timely reinforcements from a Prussian division of von L'Estocq.
en.n: Napoleon defeats the coalition forces of Russian General Bennigsen and Prussian General L'Estocq at the Battle of Eylau.

zh.s: 埃劳战役又称普鲁士埃劳战役，是拿破仑大军与列文·奥古斯特·冯·贝尼格森将军率领的俄罗斯帝国军队于1807年2月7日至8日在东普鲁士普鲁士埃劳镇附近进行的一场血腥战斗，双方在战略上未分胜负。战斗后期，冯·莱斯托克率领的普鲁士师及时增援俄军。
zh.n: 拿破仑在埃劳战役中击败俄罗斯将军贝尼格森和普鲁士将军冯·莱斯托克率领的联军。

en.s: In the War of the Sixth Coalition, the Battle of the Mincio River was fought on 8 February 1814 and resulted in an inconclusive engagement between the French under Eugène de Beauharnais and the Austrians under Field Marshal Heinrich von Bellegarde. Fought on the same ground as Napoleon's victory at the Battle of Borghetto in 1796, the battle was not as decisive as Eugène hoped, and in the end it had little significant impact upon the war, whose outcome was to be decided in France rather than Italy.

zh.s: 第六次反法同盟战争期间，明乔河战役于1814年2月8日爆发。欧仁·德·博阿尔内率领的法国军队与海因里希·冯·贝勒加德元帅率领的奥地利军队交战，双方未分胜负。战场与拿破仑1796年在博尔盖托战役取胜的地点相同，但这次战役没有达到欧仁预期的决定性结果，对战争影响不大；战争胜负最终将在法国而非意大利决定。

en.t: US Senate elects Richard M. Johnson vice president
en.s: On February 8, 1837, the United States Senate elected Richard M. Johnson vice president by 33 votes to 17 over Francis Granger. No candidate had received a majority of the electoral votes for vice president in the 1836 election.

zh.t: 美国参议院选出理查德·约翰逊为副总统
zh.s: 1837年2月8日，美国参议院以33票对17票选出理查德·约翰逊为副总统，击败弗朗西斯·格兰杰。此前的1836年选举中，没有副总统候选人获得过半选举人票。

en.s: The February 1858 Light colonial by-election was held on 8 February 1858 to elect one of two members for Light in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member Carrington Smedley resigned on 23 December 1857. William Henry Maturin won the by-election with 58 per cent of the vote.

zh.s: 1858年2月8日，南澳大利亚众议院莱特选区举行补选，选出两名议员中的一席。时任议员卡林顿·斯梅德利于1857年12月23日辞职，触发补选。威廉·亨利·马特林以58%的选票获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Slupcza took place on February 8, 1863, near the village of Slupcza, Congress Poland, during the January Uprising. Up to 100 Polish insurgents commanded by Leon Frankowski and Antoni Zdanowicz clashed on that day with a unit of the Imperial Russian Army. The skirmish was won by the Russians. In late January 1863, an insurgent unit, which was concentrated in Kurow, was forced to leave the town under Russian pressure. Polish unit marched to Sandomierz, but decided not to enter this town, and clashed with Russians near Slupcza. The Russians attacked with two infantry companies and a Cossack unit, defeating main insurgent force.

zh.s: 1863年2月8日，一月起义期间，莱昂·弗兰科夫斯基和安托尼·兹达诺维奇率最多100名波兰起义者，在波兰会议王国斯武普恰村附近与俄国帝国军队交战，俄军获胜。1月底，集结于库鲁夫的起义军在俄军压力下撤离，向桑多梅日行进，却决定不进入该城，随后在斯武普恰附近遭遇俄军。俄军以两个步兵连及一支哥萨克部队发起进攻，击败起义军主力。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 8 February 1871 to elect the first legislature of the French Third Republic, the unicameral National Assembly. The elections were held during an explosive situation in the country, as following the Franco-Prussian War, 43 departments were occupied. As a result, all public meetings were outlawed and Paris was the only city where an election campaign took place. The electoral law allowed candidates to run in more than one seat at a time. As a result, several candidates were elected in more than one seat, with Adolphe Thiers elected in 86 constituencies.

zh.s: 法国于1871年2月8日举行议会选举，选出法兰西第三共和国首个立法机构——一院制国民议会。当时国内局势极度紧张，普法战争后有43个省被占领，所有公众集会遭禁，巴黎成为唯一开展竞选活动的城市。选举法允许候选人同时竞逐多个选区，因而有人在多个选区当选。原文称阿道夫·梯也尔在86个选区获选。

en.s: The Great Sioux War of 1876, also known as the Black Hills War, was a series of battles and negotiations that occurred in 1876 and 1877 in an alliance of Lakota Sioux and Northern Cheyenne against the United States. The cause of the war was the desire of the US government to obtain ownership of the Black Hills.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1876年大苏族战争又称黑山战争，是1876至1877年间拉科塔苏族人与北夏延人结盟，对抗美国的一系列战斗和谈判。战争起因是美国政府企图取得黑山地区的所有权。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Battle of Schuinshoogte, also known as Battle of Ingogo, was fought north of Newcastle, KwaZulu-Natal, on 8 February 1881 during the First Boer War. General Sir George Pomeroy Colley's communications with Newcastle were under constant harassment by mounted Boer patrols under Commander J D Weilbach after the Battle of Laing's Nek (another British defeat) and as a result he planned to clear a path along the Newcastle-Mount Prospect road to better protect the British supply line, and receive fresh reinforcements he needed to bolster his ranks. At roughly 9 a.m. he left the Mount Prospect camp with a force consisting mostly of infantrymen.

zh.s: 斯凯恩斯霍赫特战役又称因戈戈战役，于1881年2月8日在第一次布尔战争期间发生，地点在夸祖鲁—纳塔尔纽卡斯尔以北。英军此前在莱恩隘口战败后，乔治·波默罗伊·科利爵士与纽卡斯尔之间的交通，不断遭J.D.韦尔巴赫指挥的布尔骑马巡逻队袭扰。科利计划打通纽卡斯尔至普罗斯佩克特山的道路，以保护英军补给线并接收急需援兵。上午9时左右，他率领一支以步兵为主的部队离开普罗斯佩克特山营地。

en.t: The Dawes Act is enacted, authorizing the U.S. President to divide Native American tribal land into individual allotments
en.s: The Dawes Act of 1887 (also known as the General Allotment Act or the Dawes Severalty Act of 1887) regulated land rights on tribal territories within the United States. Named after Senator Henry L. Dawes of Massachusetts, it authorized the President of the United States to subdivide Native American (Indian) tribal communal landholdings into allotments for Native American heads of families and individuals.

zh.s: 1887年《道斯法案》又称《一般分配法》或《道斯分户法》，规定了美国原住民部落领地的土地权利。该法以马萨诸塞州参议员亨利·L·道斯命名，授权美国总统将原住民部落共有土地划分为个人份额，分配给原住民家庭户主及个人。

en.s: The Battle of Port Arthur (Japanese: 旅順口海戦 Hepburn: Ryojunkō Kaisen) of 8–9 February 1904 (Monday February 8 - Tuesday February 9) marked the commencement of the Russo-Japanese War. It began with a surprise night attack by a squadron of Japanese destroyers on the Russian fleet anchored at Port Arthur, Manchuria, and continued with an engagement of major surface combatants the following morning; further skirmishing off Port Arthur would continue until May 1904. The battle itself ended inconclusively, though the war itself ended in a decisive Japanese victory.

zh.s: 1904年2月8日星期一至9日星期二的旅顺口海战，标志着日俄战争开始。日本驱逐舰编队先夜袭停泊在中国东北旅顺港的俄国舰队，次日早晨双方主力水面舰艇继续交战。旅顺外海的零星战斗持续到1904年5月。这场海战本身未分胜负，但整场战争最终以日本取得决定性胜利告终。

en.s: The Russo-Japanese War began on the night of 8–9 February 1904, when Japanese naval forces attacked the Russian fleet at Port Arthur, in present-day Lüshun, China. Japan and Russia were competing for influence in Manchuria and Korea.
en.n: The source records the war’s start as February 8; the opening naval action took place overnight on February 8–9.

zh.s: 1904年2月8日至9日夜间，日本海军袭击驻泊旅顺的俄国舰队，日俄战争由此爆发。两国争夺的是在中国东北和朝鲜的势力范围。旅顺位于今中国。
zh.n: 原文将战争开始日期记为2月8日，最初的海上袭击发生在2月8日至9日夜间。

en.s: The Argentine Revolution of 1905 also known as the Radical Revolution of 1905 (Spanish: Revolución radical de 1905) was a civil-military uprising organized by the Radical Civic Union and headed by Hipólito Yrigoyen against the oligarchic dominance known as the Roquismo led by Julio Argentino Roca and his National Autonomist Party.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1905年阿根廷革命又称1905年激进派革命，是激进公民联盟组织的一场军民起义，由伊波利托·伊里戈延领导，反抗胡利奥·阿根蒂诺·罗卡及其国家自治党主导的寡头统治。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Batman on 8 February 1911. This was triggered by the death of Labour MP Henry Beard. The by-election was won by Labour candidate Frank Brennan.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院巴特曼选区于1911年2月8日举行补选。工党议员亨利·比尔德去世，议席因此出缺。工党候选人弗兰克·布伦南赢得补选。

en.s: The Battle of Bulair (Bulgarian: Битка при Була ир, Turkish: Bolayır Muharebesi) took place on 8 February 1913 (O.S. 26 January 1913) between the Bulgarian Seventh Rila Infantry Division under General Georgi Todorov and the Ottoman 27th Infantry Division. The result was a Bulgarian victory. Lack of communication between the Ottoman Vanguard and their landing force and stubbornness of Enver Pasha against the combined criticism from officers Ali Fethi and Mustafa Kemal against his plans costed the Ottoman 27th Brigade their full offensive capabilities.

Nazi Germany was also involved through air and naval support. The participation of Moroccan regulars and especially of modern and armoured Italian forces from the recently arrived Corpo Truppe Volontarie resulted in a complete rout of the Spanish Republican Army and the capitulation of Málaga in less than a week.

en.s: On 8 February 1948, the Korean People’s Army was formally established in northern Korea, in the territory of present-day North Korea. The February establishment is distinct from the April 25 date later used to commemorate an earlier guerrilla organization.

en.s: The Orangeburg Massacre was a shooting of student protesters on Thursday February 8, 1968, on the campus of South Carolina State College in Orangeburg, South Carolina, United States. Nine highway patrolmen and one city police officer opened fire on a crowd of African American students, killing three and injuring twenty-eight. The shootings were the culmination of a series of protests against de facto racial segregation at a local bowling alley, marking the first instance of police killing student protestors at an American university. Two days before the shootings, student activists had been arrested for a sit-in at the segregated All-Star Bowling Lane.

zh.s: 1968年2月8日星期四，美国南卡罗来纳州奥兰治堡的南卡罗来纳州立学院发生向学生抗议者开枪的惨案。九名公路巡警和一名市警向非裔学生人群开火，造成三人死亡、28人受伤。学生此前连续抗议当地一家保龄球馆实行事实上的种族隔离，两天前还有活动人士因在实行隔离的全明星保龄球馆静坐而被捕。这是美国大学首次出现警方杀害学生抗议者的事件。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Scullin in Victoria (Australia) on 8 February 1986. Scullin had always been a very safe Labor seat, and the election was won easily by Labor candidate Harry Jenkins (the former member's son), despite a swing to the Liberal Party.

en.s: Caucuses in Iowa for the Democratic presidential nomination were held on February 8, marking the Democratic Party's first nominating contest in their series of presidential primaries ahead of the 1988 presidential election. Dick Gephardt, having focused his campaign against offshoring, won a plurality in the preference vote and precinct caucuses. However, Michael Dukakis, who placed third in both of those contests, received a plurality of the delegates to the national convention.

en.s: An indirect election for the position of President of the Hellenic Republic was held by the Hellenic Parliament on 8 February 2000. Incumbent President Konstantinos Stephanopoulos was elected on the first ballot with 269 votes out of 298, with the support of the two major parties, the ruling PASOK and New Democracy, against 10 votes for Synaspismos' candidate Leonidas Kyrkos. The 19 MPs of the Communist Party of Greece and DIKKI voted "present", and two were absent. Stephanopoulos' re-election to the presidency marked the first time in the history of the Third Hellenic Republic that the ruling party and the main opposition party both supported the same candidate, as well as the first time that an incumbent President was re-elected.

zh.s: 希腊议会于2000年2月8日举行间接总统选举。现任总统康斯坦丁诺斯·斯特凡诺普洛斯获得执政的泛希腊社会主义运动和主要反对党新民主党支持，在首轮298张选票中取得269票；左翼联盟候选人莱奥尼达斯·基尔科斯获得十票。希腊共产党及民主社会运动的19名议员投“出席票”，另有两人缺席。这是希腊第三共和国历史上，执政党与主要反对党首次共同支持同一位总统候选人，也是现任总统首次连任。

en.s: An indirect election for the position of President of the Hellenic Republic was held by the Hellenic Parliament on 8 February 2005. Running unopposed, veteran PASOK politician and former Foreign Minister of Greece Karolos Papoulias was elected on the first ballot with the record number of 279 votes, with 163 MPs of the ruling New Democracy party, 114 MPs of PASOK and two independent MPs voting in support, four MPs absent, while the 17 MPs of Synaspismos and the Communist Party of Greece voted "present". He was sworn in on 12 March 2005, succeeding Konstantinos Stephanopoulos.

en.s: The 2005 Manihiki by-election was a by-election in the Cook Islands electorate of Manihiki. It was held on 8 February 2005, shortly after the 2004 general election, and was precipitated by an electoral petition finding the result in the seat to be a dead tie. Both parties to the petition, Prime Minister Robert Woonton and Cook Islands Party leader Henry Puna had agreed that in the event of a draw the question should be decided by the voters, and so Woonton resigned.

en.s: A parliamentary election was held in Djibouti on 8 February 2008. There were 65 candidates running for the 65 seats in the National Assembly, with all of the candidates coming from the ruling coalition, the Union for the Presidential Majority (UMP). The opposition boycotted the election, and the UMP won all 65 seats. In boycotting the election, the opposition complained that the electoral system guaranteed victory for the UMP; in the previous January 2003 parliamentary election, the UMP won all 65 seats even though the opposition won 38% of the vote. The opposition unsuccessfully demanded that proportional representation be introduced.

zh.s: 吉布提于2008年2月8日举行议会选举。国民议会65席共有65名候选人，全部来自执政联盟总统多数联盟，反对派则抵制选举，最终该联盟包揽全部席位。反对派称，选制保证执政联盟获胜：2003年1月上届选举中，反对派虽获得38%的选票，执政联盟仍拿走全部65席。反对派曾要求改行比例代表制，但未成功。

en.s: On February 8, 2023, bus driver Pierre Ny St-Amand deliberately crashed Société de transport de Laval (STL) bus into a daycare in Laval, Quebec, Canada, killing two children and injuring six others. St-Amand was quickly subdued by bystanders and arrested. Trauma support was provided to affected families and residents. Quebec Premier François Legault and Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau visited the area to pay respects in the days following the incident. St-Amand, a father of two with no prior criminal record, was arrested on eight charges. A Quebec Superior Court ordered a psychiatric evaluation to assess his mental state during the crash.

zh.t: 拉瓦尔幼儿园巴士撞击案
